theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (N : ℕ) (ν : X → Rn N), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → Measurable[μ.toOuterMeasure.caratheodory] ν → ∃ ν' : X → Rn N, StronglyMeasurable ν' ∧ ν =ᵐ[μ] ν'
